items.summary: For more than half a century, Bob Vogelbaugh has welcomed hundreds of guests, including friends and strangers alike, to share a free holiday meal.

items.headline: How do election recounts work in Iowa?
items.summary: Candidates in Iowa must be the ones to submit a request for a recount. State law does not allow for it to be automatically ordered.

items.headline: John Deere plant closure leaves 400 people in Ottumwa without a job
